content_sections.text: A total of 116 UGD Helper posts are notified, all carrying the same pay scale of Rs. 27,000–46,675. content_sections.heading: Mysore City Corporation UGD Helper Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidate must be conversant in Kannada. Candidate must currently be working in Mysuru Mahanagara Palike on a daily-wage/ welfare/ equal-pay-for-equal-work/ contract/ outsourcing basis, performing the same or equivalent UGD Helper-type duties, and must have completed a minimum of 2 years of continuous service in that capacity. Candidates engaged through STP (Sewage Treatment Plant) or Wet Well contract arrangements are excluded from this recruitment. Candidates must be able to produce ESI and PF documents (paid by the Corporation on their behalf), duly certified by the concerned officials. This is a restricted/internal-eligibility recruitment - candidates not already engaged with MCC in the manner described above are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Mysore City Corporation UGD Helper Salary
content_sections.text: Selected UGD Helpers will be placed in the pay scale of Rs. 27,000 – Rs. 46,675, as fixed for the post under the Corporation's cadre and pay rules.

content_sections.heading: Mysore City Corporation UGD Helper Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made purely on merit, based on the length of continuous service rendered in the qualifying category of employment with MCC - there is no written exam or interview. Where two or more candidates have equal service length, the older candidate (by date of birth) is given preference. If both service length and date of birth are identical, selection between such candidates is decided by lottery. A provisional selection list is published per Rule 4 read with Rule 5, followed by objections/representations and a final list approved by the Selection & Direct Recruitment Authority-cum-Commissioner, MCC.

content_sections.heading: Mysore City Corporation UGD Helper Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled prescribed application form Recent passport-size photograph affixed on the form, with signature/left-thumb impression Proof of date of birth Proof of current engagement and service length with MCC (in the qualifying employment category) certified by the competent branch head ESI and PF documents certified by the concerned MCC officials Caste and income/creamy-layer certificates, where reservation is claimed Rural candidate certificate, where applicable Disability certificate from the district medical board, where applicable Ex-servicemen discharge/service certificate, where applicable Project-displaced family certificate, where applicable Kannada-medium study certificate, where applicable (for the Kannada-medium candidate provision) Third-gender certificate from the competent authority, where applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mysore City Corporation UGD Helper Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect the prescribed application form from the MCC Central Office, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru-570004 (forms are issued free of cost). Fill in all columns of the application completely and accurately. Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign or affix a left-thumb impression on the form. Attach self-attested copies of all supporting certificates listed under Documents Required. Submit the completed application directly at the MCC Central Office on or before 9 October 2026, 5:30 PM. Applications sent by post or dropped off through any other channel will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Mysore City Corporation UGD Helper Important Instructions

faq.answer: It is a special recruitment by Mysuru Mahanagara Palike (Mysore City Corporation) to fill 116 UGD Helper posts, restricted to existing MCC daily-wage/contract staff with at least 2 years of service.

faq.answer: Ability to speak Kannada, and current engagement with MCC on daily-wage/ contract/ outsourcing/ equal-pay terms with at least 2 years of service; no separate educational qualification is specified in the notification.
